style: vintage 1950s Christmas card illustration, retro mid-century cartoon character with big expressive eyes and rosy cheeks, detailed confident linework, thick bold dark outlines, flat colors with halftone dot shading and grainy distressed screen print texture, muted retro red, green, cream, teal and mustard, large dense maximalist composition that fills the whole frame, the subject tightly surrounded by a packed cluster of holly leaves with berries, pine sprigs, red plaid ribbon bows, candy canes, round ornaments and four-point stars, strictly flat 2D vector sticker art, hand-drawn screen printed look
title: Retro Christmas Sublimation PNG Bundle, Funny Vintage Shirt Designs, Santa Snowman Reindeer
